touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Beddgelert qualifies as a local detour through St Mary's Church, Beddgelert; St Mary's Priory (Augustinian) and Parish Church of St Mary. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.
